sources.snippet: The problem: Qwen 3.x/3.5 models emit reasoning/thinking tokens in streaming mode. These tokens go into a reasoning field instead of content, which causes OpenAI-compatible clients to see empty responses. Your model appears to not respond at all — no error, just silence. sources.title: Run & Benchmark Qwen3.5 0.8B: Smallest Multimodal AI Model
sources.snippet: Quick answer. Qwen3.5 0.8B is Alibaba's smallest multimodal model, with a 262K context window and native vision support. Pull it with `ollama run qwen3.5:0.8b` for text or run the GGUF in llama.cpp for image input. Expect strong recall but weak code accuracy — bump to Qwen3.5 4B for any coding task.
